title: Bob Marley And The Wailers - Burnin

lines.l: This morning, I woke up in a curfew
Oh God, I was a prisoner too
Could not recognize the faces standing over me
We were all dressed in uniforms of brutality
How many rivers do we have to cross
Before we can talk to the boss
All that we got, it seems we have lost
We must not really pay the cost
I say we're gonna burn and elute
Give me the food and let me grow
Let the roots man take a blow
All them drugs gonna make you swollen
It's not the music of the ghetto
Weeping so break these long, long years
Give me the food and let me grow
Let the rude man take the blow
Hey, I said, fallin', fallin', don't make it slow
It's not the music of the ghetto
We're gonna be burning and eluting tonight
